description: Published coupling-exceptions manifest. Enumerates every deliberate exemption from the generic-core product-coupling gates: inline contract-allow markers (drift-gate scanner, forbidden-terms.ts) and D99_ALLOWLIST compatibility literals (allowlist.d99.ts). coupling-exceptions.manifest.test.ts asserts this manifest's per-file and total counts match the live scan and the frozen constants; it is an audit artifact and does not modify scan logic. v2 drops the per-entry line number v1 carried: the gate never verified it, so it rotted silently as the exempted files grew. The exempted file is the durable locator; the exact lines are recovered live with `grep -n contract-allow: <file>`.
